sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We appreciate your prompt response and are willing to agree to a 24-month contract to support our long-standing partnership with stability. However, an extension to 60 days for payment is not feasible for our family-run foundry; we propose 45 days as a fair compromise. 

With these adjusted terms, we can offer a revised price of €52.60 per unit. Under this proposal, our offer stands at a price of €52.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €52.40 per unit, under an option with a price of €52.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. As a family-run business, we value constructive negotiations that move towards a mutual agreement. We therefore maintain our previous offer of €52.60 for a 60-day payment term, and kindly ask you to reconsider your position.

For your reference, our offer stands at a price of €52.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Our foundry has always taken pride in the deep roots and long-standing partnerships we share within our region. It is with this spirit of commitment and mutual trust that we remain at your service, and we look forward to finding a good way forward together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to do business with valued regional partners like Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

Our foundry stands by the craftsmanship of our people and the depth of our partnership. With that shared history in mind, we have already accommodated your requests for a 24-month contract and 60-day payment terms to support our long-standing partnership. Therefore, we maintain our offer of €52.60 and kindly ask you to return to a constructive negotiation basis.

To confirm the details of our offer, we stand at a price of €52.60 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 60 days net, and a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our work together and reaching a mutual agreement soon.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.body: Fourth and last counter; please review.

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We observe that your proposed prices continue to decrease, which does not provide a constructive basis for negotiation. As a family-run foundry that values our 12-year relationship, we expect a serious step towards a mutual agreement.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We maintain our offer of a price of €52.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This Angebot is valid for 7 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
